Have Ferrari’s V12 GT cars gotten BETTER or WORSE over time?
It’s time for an incredible Ferrari V12 showdown!
We’ve got our hands on a 12Cilindri Spider, an 812 GTS, an F12, and a 599 GTB, and they’re about to go head-to-head over the quarter mile!
The question is, will the more recent releases leave the others in their wake? Or could the F12 or 599 spring a surprise on the others? Let’s take a closer look at the stats…
